pages.text: $(bold)SlashBlade$()$(br2)How to obtain: build it at the $(bold)Tinker Station$() - $(bold)sheath + blade + tough handle$().$(br2)The sheath and the blade are new parts added by this mod: make them at the Part Builder with their patterns, or cast them from molten metal (the gold cast is reusable, the sand and red sand casts are single use).$(br2)Stats: the blade is the primary part - 4.0 attack, 1.6 attack speed, 200 base durability.

$(bold)Iai slash$()$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Hold right-click$() to charge, release to cut: a $(bold)frontal arc slash$() that hits everything in range and pushes you forward$(li)A $(bold)full charge$() (about 1 second) means more damage, more range and a longer lunge$(li)Too short a charge does nothing; there is a 1-2 second cooldown afterwards$(br2)$(bold)SlashBlade integration$()$(br2)With SlashBlade: Resharped installed, this tool hooks into it: the blade state (proud soul, kill count, refine, combo and special arts) lives on the blade. Current progress: $(bold)combos and special arts$() are still being implemented.
